protocol: Comparison set is fixed a priori; there is no selection stage, so the whole set is evaluated once on TEST (n=100).
TUNE (n=50) is computed for transparency only and is not used to choose anything.
Arms: minmax (released control protocol, primary) and zscore (repository's alternative calibration, secondary = score-distribution shift).
control protocol: dense branches over the whole 121-clip gallery, calibrated over the whole gallery. Systems: prior_only (source-count-ratio alpha) and fixed_0.5 (equal-weight calibrated fusion).

prod protocol (production candidate model): structured shortlist = clips with a structured result (threshold 0.05, the control's own n_structured rule), semantic shortlist = top-20 semantic hits (the control's own n_semantic), union = the gallery, each branch calibrated over its own shortlist, missing candidates zero-filled. Systems: prior_only_prod, comb_sum_cal, comb_anz_cal, comb_mnz_cal.

Statistic: macro P@5 (mean of five category means). Primary: paired bootstrap with within-category resampling (n_boot=3000). Secondary: grouped 5-minute-cluster bootstrap on the macro statistic, pooled per-query paired bootstrap, pooled per-query grouped bootstrap, Wilcoxon signed-rank, paired sign-flip randomisation.
Holm: one family per calibration arm (4 comparisons) plus a conservative global family over all 8 arm-level comparisons.
The paper's metadata prior alpha is reused unchanged; these are competing baselines, not replacements.

literature.comb_sum: CombSUM (normalise-then-sum) of Fox & Shaw, 'Combination of Multiple Searches', TREC-2 (NIST, 1994), https://trec.nist.gov/pubs/trec2/papers/txt/23.txt
literature.comb_anz: CombANZ (normalise-then-sum, multiplied by the number of systems that returned the document) of Fox & Shaw, TREC-2 (1994); the UMass CIIR 'Analysis of Multiple Evidence Combination' report https://ciir-publications.cs.umass.edu/getpdf.php?id=63
literature.comb_mnz: CombMNZ (CombANZ with the count taken over the systems that assigned a non-zero score) of Fox & Shaw, TREC-2 (1994); Lee (1997), 'Hybrid test collections and the fusion of retrieval systems'
literature.empty_branch: Empty-branch rebalancing: a branch that returns nothing must not deflate the other branch (the canonical fix for an empty result set); see also Raza et al. (2019) 'A survey on deep learning for hybrid information retrieval', and the UMass CIIR evidence-combination report

qc_count_01.note: the paper's alpha keeps the empty branch's weight, so the surviving branch is multiplied by (1 - alpha) (by 0 when alpha = 1): its scores are deflated and are not comparable across queries.  The calibrated rules keep the surviving branch at full scale.

verdict.robustness_direction: ROBUST (the sign and the size of the calibrated-vs-prior difference are preserved under every candidate-set-size and score-distribution perturbation)

notes.winner: no calibrated baseline is Holm-significant against the prior-only baseline in either arm
notes.probe_drop: absolute macro P@5 drop from the full gallery to the worst candidate-set-size cell: prior_only_prod -0.2060, the three calibrated baselines -0.1740 on average (the drop is driven by the gallery losing relevant candidates, and is shared by all methods)
notes.probe_stability: comb_sum_cal: delta range [-0.0260, -0.0080], sign stable=True; comb_anz_cal: delta range [-0.1660, -0.0280], sign stable=True; comb_mnz_cal: delta range [-0.0400, -0.0100], sign stable=True
notes.distribution_shift: score-distribution shift (calibrated structured branch x^2): prior_only_prod@warp_struct=0.5380 (alpha 0.619), comb_sum_cal@warp_struct=0.5200 (alpha 0.619), comb_anz_cal@warp_struct=0.3720 (alpha 0.619), comb_mnz_cal@warp_struct=0.5020 (alpha 0.619), prior_only_prod@warp_struct_half_both=0.4040 (alpha 0.619), comb_sum_cal@warp_struct_half_both=0.3960 (alpha 0.619), comb_anz_cal@warp_struct_half_both=0.3500 (alpha 0.619), comb_mnz_cal@warp_struct_half_both=0.3940 (alpha 0.619)
notes.empty_branch: with an empty branch the source-count-ratio prior collapses to an all-zero fused score (degenerate ranking) in 1 case(s): prior_only_prod@qc_count_01/empty_structured; the calibrated rules keep the surviving branch at full scale
notes.comparison_outcome: no calibrated baseline beats the source-count-ratio prior-only baseline Holm-significantly on test; the simple calibrated fusion is at best a tie under the released control protocol

limitations: Single camera (camera_0) and a 2-hour released window; the numbers are not the paper's full 4-camera / 312k-descriptor deployment results.
Labels are derived from released VLM captions, detector metadata and snapshots, not human annotations; no inter-annotator agreement is available.

The control harness scores every clip with the metadata structured branch (it is a dense scoring function, not a real structured search); the production candidate model therefore approximates the structured shortlist with the control's own n_structured rule (score > 0.05).
CombANZ/CombMNZ are applied to the two-branch case only; with a dense branch pair the count factor is nearly constant, so they can coincide with CombSUM -- that is reported, not hidden.
The probe is descriptive (stability under perturbation), not a hypothesis test; the CIs are bootstrap intervals over queries.
The alpha prior, the benchmark, the metrics and the statistical protocol are imported unchanged from the released control driver.
